Both Go binaries of rpi-connect-lite 2.12.2, /usr/bin/rpi-connect and /usr/bin/rpi-connectd, were checked with govulncheck -mode=binary on 2026-09-12. The vulnerable symbols are linked into the binaries. Whether the code path is reachable on the printer has not been established; Raspberry Pi owns the build and the fix is a rebuild with Go 1.26.6. golang.org/x/net/idna via net/http: ASCII-only Punycode labels accepted. Client side of Connect's HTTPS connections.

Whether the code path is reachable on the printer has not been established; Raspberry Pi owns the build and the fix is a rebuild with Go 1.26.6. dnsmessage: panic on an invalid SVCB or HTTPS record, reachable through net.LookupCNAME. The resolver is the HMI on the printer VLAN.
